terms.title: Terms of Use (Terms & DPA)
terms.description: FOVE SaaS service agreement and personal data processing agreement.
terms.highlight: You remain the sole owner of your customer list. No commission on your sales and no hidden commitment.

purpose.title: 1. Purpose of the service
purpose.text: FOVE (published by Dizayna) provides merchants and businesses with a SaaS platform to create and manage digital loyalty programs (points or stamp cards, QR codes at the counter, Apple/Google Wallet, CRM and API).

account.title: 2. Merchant account and responsibilities
account.text: The merchant is responsible for keeping their credentials confidential, managing their team’s permissions (owner, manager, cashier, viewer) and for the lawfulness of the business rules and rewards they offer to their customers.

plans.title: 3. Free plan, subscription and continuity
plans.text: Signing up gives access to the Free plan, with no time limit and no credit card. When a subscription ends or the plan changes, no existing card or points balance is deleted: only new items beyond the active plan’s quotas are suspended until an upgrade.

data.title: 4. Data ownership and processing (DPA)
data.text: The merchant remains the sole owner of their customer base and the data controller within the meaning of the GDPR. Dizayna acts solely as a technical processor (article 28 of the GDPR), refrains from any resale or commercial use of customer data, and guarantees full exportability (JSON/CSV) at any time.

security.title: 5. Security and ledger integrity
security.text: Points and stamp operations are recorded in an immutable, audited ledger. Any attempt at fraudulent use, spam or undermining the platform’s security may result in the immediate suspension of the account.

privacy.title: Personal data policy
privacy.description: How FOVE and Dizayna protect and process your data and your customers’ data.
privacy.highlight: Strict compliance with GDPR standards: data isolation, export and anonymization rights in 1 click.

controller.title: 1. Who is the data controller?
controller.text: Each merchant is the controller of their own customers’ data (their customer list and the rules of their loyalty program). Dizayna, publisher of FOVE, acts as a technical processor: we host and secure this data on the merchant’s behalf, strictly following their instructions.

collected.title: 2. What data is collected?
collected.merchants: Merchants and sales teams: last name, first name, work email, access role and audit log of counter operations.
collected.customers: Customers: first name, last name, phone number, email (optional), loyalty card number, visit history, accumulated points/stamps and rewards redeemed.

consent.title: 3. Separate consents
consent.text: Joining the loyalty program and consenting to marketing messages (SMS, WhatsApp, email) are strictly separate. A customer can use their loyalty card without agreeing to receive promotional offers.

rights.title: 4. Individual rights (Access, Export, Erasure)
rights.text: The merchant can export all of a customer’s data in standard JSON format at any time, or permanently erase it from the customer record. Erasure immediately anonymizes the person: the accounting history is kept without any identifying data.

retention.title: 5. Retention period
retention.text: An inactive customer’s data is kept for 36 months by default (a period the merchant can configure in their settings). Expired authentication tokens and codes are purged automatically.

security.title: 6. Security and hosting
security.text: Strict multi-tenant isolation in the database, passwords protected by strong cryptographic hashing, encryption of integration secrets (AES-256-GCM), immutable traceability of records and daily backups.
